requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject conflation of claimed disclosed and experimentally demonstrated evidence states
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Evidenzmodell requires CLAIMED, disclosed embodiments and EXPERIMENTALLY_DEMONSTRATED evidence to remain distinct.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject exact epitope inference from competition binding without residue-level support
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The binding architecture section explicitly rejects treating competition binding as proof of an exact residue epitope.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject direct ranking of incompatible binding or assay measurements without method context
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The quantitative-data section requires method/platform and measurement context and says measurements from different methods must not be ranked as directly comparable without context.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reframe redesign directions as technical hypotheses and require product-specific FTO before clearance conclusions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The design-space section permits technical hypotheses only, says not to claim they are patent-free and routes concrete configurations to freedom-to-operate-assessment.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: preserve invented assay conditions or unsupported biological details
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The prerequisites, boundary and reconstruction rules prohibit hallucinated details and silent completion of missing assay or sequence information.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: state that a proposed technical redesign is patent free
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The design-space workflow explicitly prohibits claiming a proposed direction is patent-free.
